description_en: Retrieves the list of API operations
name: ListHttpApiOperations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target HTTP API
parameters.name: http_api_id

parameters.help_en: Searches for operations by path prefix match
parameters.help_zh: 按路径前缀匹配搜索接口
parameters.name: path_like

parameters.help_en: Searches for operations by name prefix
parameters.help_zh: 按接口名称前缀搜索接口
parameters.name: name_like

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，不填默认1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，有效范围[1, 100]，不填默认10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Searches for operations by exact name match
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The environment ID. When specified together with withConsumerInfoById, the response includes the authorization rule list of the specified consumer in the specified environment for each operation
parameters.help_zh: 响应中每个接口信息携带指定环境ID下的指定消费者的授权规则列表。需要额外指定withConsumerInfoById字段
parameters.name: with_consumer_in_environment_id

parameters.help_en: The consumer ID. When specified together with withConsumerInEnvironmentId, the response includes the authorization rule list of the specified consumer in the specified environment for each operation
parameters.help_zh: 响应中每个接口信息携带指定环境ID下的指定消费者的授权规则列表。需要额外指定withConsumerInEnvironmentId字段
parameters.name: with_consumer_info_by_id

parameters.help_en: The consumer authorization rule ID used to filter the operation list. The response includes only operations that are authorized by the specified rule
parameters.help_zh: 根据特定的消费者授权规则ID过滤接口列表，响应中的接口列表仅包含已授权的接口
parameters.name: consumer_authorization_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The plugin ID used to retrieve plugin deployment information
parameters.help_zh: 插件ID，根据此插件ID获取插件发布信息
parameters.name: with_plugin_attachment_by_plugin_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the request is for a deployment scenario
parameters.name: for_deploy
